headlines.description: Belgium came from behind to earn a comprehensive 4-1 win over Italy and progress through to the quarterfinals of the Nations League.
headlines.shortLinkText: Belgium power past Italy to reach Nations League quarterfinals

headlines.description: France booked their place in the Nations League quarterfinals with a 2-1 victory over Türkiye in Bordeaux on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: France beat Türkiye to top group, advance to Nations League quarterfinals

headlines.description: England ended 2026 with an extraordinary 3-2 triumph in world champions Spain's backyard as Thomas Tuchel's 10 men dug deep to top their Nations League group on a magical night in Madrid.
headlines.shortLinkText: England hold on for remarkable win in Madrid to end Spain's 43-game unbeaten run
